messages:
Alex: Hey — requesting a rebase slot for PR #8129 https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8129. It's a big one (scheduler + batching changes). We should merge before the deploy freeze on Thu 2026-04-01. CI flaky: tests/kv_cache_test is intermittently failing. Any chance for a rebase window or someone to help rerun CI?

Mira: @Alex can you split into a pure refactor + follow-up? If not, our usual guidance is to merge at least 48h before freeze so we have time for rollbacks. There's a small rebase window tomorrow at 09:30 PT, but it's tight. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Alex: splitting would be painful for this diff (touches scheduler & runtime). I'd prefer to land as-is if we can get a clean CI and one extra reviewer. 48h rule makes sense, but the next available window after that is 5 days out which would delay feature.

Sam: What exactly is failing? If it's a flaky test we can try a targeted rerun. ci-bot can rerun the individual job: use the run id or `ci-bot rerun <job>` to avoid a full pipeline.

Alex: Failure is nondeterministic in kv_cache_test::eviction_smoke on GPU builders. No obvious root yet. Local repro is flaky.

Sam: Ok. Try this quick command to requeue just the failing job: ```bash
# from PR page
ci-bot rerun 8129 --job=kv_cache_test::eviction_smoke
```
If that still flakes, we should run a serial stress on our internal repro infra.

ci-bot: Rerun queued for PR #8129, job kv_cache_test::eviction_smoke. Run ID: 7890123. 1 attempt in progress. Use `ci-bot status 7890123` to follow.

Ryan: I can give a review after CI goes green. @Jamie can you give the final +1 for runtime-scheduler changes? Jamie usually approves these.

Jamie: Pinged. I'll take a look after the rerun completes. If CI passes, I'll aim to approve today. :thumbsup:

Mira: If we plan to merge during tomorrow's 09:30 PT rebase window, we need: (1) green CI, (2) two approvers (Ryan + Jamie), (3) a short rollback plan in case latency regresses. Can you draft a one-paragraph rollback note, @Alex?

Alex: Will do. Draft rollback plan: revert PR #8129 -> redeploy previous model variant -> 10m smoke test on /health and a sampling of p50/p95 latency. I'll paste the short plan here before the window.

Sam: Also add a CI tag to force serial job runs for the flaky test in this PR while we investigate: `ci/serial-kv-cache`. That reduces noise for other PRs.

Alex: Added `ci/serial-kv-cache` to the PR. Rerun is green so far per ci-bot.

ci-bot: Run 7890123 completed: kv_cache_test::eviction_smoke — SUCCESS. Full pipeline status: PARTIAL (other unrelated flaky jobs still running).

Ryan: I'll start the review now. If I leave comments, tagging for follow-up.

(20m later)

Ryan: Comments posted — mostly nits and one question about batch window sizing. Not blocking.

Jamie: Reviewed and left one suggestion on the metrics naming. Once that's addressed, I can approve.

Alex: Addressed both comments and pushed a tiny follow-up commit. Requesting approvals.

ci-bot: PR #8129 status: All required checks for merge are green. Approvals: Ryan ✅, Jamie ✅. Merge queue window requested: 2026-03-25T09:30:00-07:00 (09:30 PT).

Mira: All set. I'll hold the rebase slot at 09:30 PT tomorrow. Please be ready to rollback if we see latency bump.

Alex: Thanks everyone. I'll keep monitoring perf dashboards during and after the merge. :eyes:
